text: At TARIL, we offer a comprehensive range of high-quality transformers and industrial solutions tailored to meet diverse industry needs. From high voltage transformers to specialty transformers, our products are engineered for reliability, performance, and safety.

text: TARIL's special transformers like converter duty variants are tailored for motor drives, featuring multi-pulse windings, snubber circuits, and harmonic mitigation, with options for copper/aluminum windings, sealed designs, and ester or mineral oil insulation.

text: TARIL's furnace transformers deliver high secondary currents, wide output regulation, and integrated arc-stabilizing series reactors. Available in single or three-phase variants, they feature built-in snubbers, LV cooling options, and tailored oil-water heat exchangers.

text: TARIL's shunt reactors enhance power system efficiency by absorbing reactive power in high-voltage lines. Offered up to 135 MVAr at 765 kV, they come in single or three-phase designs, with options for variable ratings, ester filling, and fast delivery.

text: Rectifier transformers from TARIL are designed for high harmonic currents in DC processes. They feature configurable LV terminals and oil-to-water heat exchangers for electrolysis and metal smelting applications.

Manufacturing Plants
text: TARIL has three manufacturing plants in India. Moraiya plant capacity is over 40,000 MVA. Changodar plant capacity is over 35,000 MVA. Odhav plant capacity is 2,000 MVA. Total installed capacity exceeds 75,000 MVA annually. TARIL exports to 40+ countries with 18,000+ installations worldwide.
